newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil redundancy plan to cost $900 mln - ministry.
newsitem.headline: Brazil redundancy plan to cost $900 mln - ministry.

text.p: A voluntary redundancy scheme, part of the Brazilian government's program to streamline the federal administration, will cost around $900 million, a senior Finance Ministry official said.

National Treasury notes will be issued to meet the immediate cost of the program which is expected to accumulate savings equivalent to the $900 million outlay within 20 months, the ministry's executive secretary Pedro Parente told reporters.
Parente did not say how many civil servants the government hopes to persuade to take voluntary retirement. Newspaper reports have put the number at around 30,000.
The voluntary retirement plan is one of several cost-cutting measures included in a wide-ranging package unveiled by the government earlier this month.
